title: Identifying the active components and mechanisms of Toona sinensis pericarps for the treatment of diabetic kidney disease using network pharmacology and experimental verification.
authors: Zhang, Yufeng; Li, Huiting; Sun, Weining; Wang, Rongshen; Li, Zhongxin; Chen, Ying; Lan, Shuying; Wang, Yuxin; Liu, Wenshan; Li, Wanzhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香椿果皮提取物治疗糖尿病肾病，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Toona sinensis is used to treat diabetic kidney disease (DKD). However, the potential bioactive components and effects of T. sinensis pericarps dichloromethane extracts (DCME) on DKD are poorly understood. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to determine the therapeutic effects and active components of DCME on DKD using network pharmacology and experimental verification. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Interactions between DCME components and disease targets were determined and verified using network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations. DKD was induced in mice with a high-fat, high-glucose diet and streptozotocin to explore the therapeutic effects of DCME. High-glucose was administered to glomerular mesangial cells to explore the therapeutic mechanisms of strongly active DCME compounds identified by molecular docking. RESULTS: Twenty-one active DCME compounds and 325 potential targets were identified using network pharmacology. The GO and KEGG analyses revealed that DCME modulates multiple biological processes. Fasting blood glucose, and liver and kidney indices were significantly reduced in mice after treatment with DCME. DCME decreased MDA, NF-kappaB, TGF-beta1, TNF-alpha, and IL-6 levels, and increased SOD, Nrf2, and HO-1 levels, ameliorating inflammation and oxidative stress. Pathological glomerular and tubule structures were restored by DCME. C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, and C19 were identified as core DCME components, and TNF, ALB, EGFR, CASP3, STAT3, BCL2, SRC, PPARG, JUN, and NFkappaB1 were identified as core targets. C6 and C7 formed stable hydrogen-bond interactions with NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha. C6 significantly attenuated increased NF-kappaB and TNF-alpha levels and activated Nrf2 and HO-1 better than C7. CONCLUSION: DCME and C6, potential candidates for the treatment of DKD, may inhibit the NF-kappaB pathway and activate the Nrf2 pathway to improve DKD.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：香椿（Toona sinensis）用于治疗糖尿病肾病（DKD）。然而，香椿果皮二氯甲烷提取物（DCME）的潜在生物活性成分及其对DKD的作用尚不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在通过网络药理学和实验验证，确定DCME对DKD的治疗效果及活性成分。材料与方法：利用网络药理学、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，确定并验证DCME成分与疾病靶点之间的相互作用。通过高脂高糖饮食和链脲佐菌素诱导小鼠DKD，以探讨DCME的治疗效果。对肾小球系膜细胞施以高糖处理，以探讨分子对接鉴定的强活性DCME化合物的治疗机制。结果：通过网络药理学鉴定出21种DCME活性化合物和325个潜在靶点。GO和KEGG分析显示，DCME调节多种生物过程。DCME治疗后，小鼠空腹血糖、肝脏和肾脏指数显著降低。DCME降低了MDA、NF-kappaB、TGF-beta1、TNF-alpha和IL-6水平，并增加了SOD、Nrf2和HO-1水平，从而改善炎症和氧化应激。DCME恢复了病理性的肾小球和肾小管结构。C2、C3、C4、C6、C7和C19被鉴定为核心DCME成分，TNF、ALB、EGFR、CASP3、STAT3、BCL2、SRC、PPARG、JUN和NFkappaB1被鉴定为核心靶点。C6和C7与NF-kappaB和TNF-alpha形成稳定的氢键相互作用。C6显著减弱了NF-kappaB和TNF-alpha水平的升高，并比C7更好地激活了Nrf2和HO-1。结论：DCME和C6是治疗DKD的潜在候选药物，可能通过抑制NF-kappaB通路并激活Nrf2通路来改善DKD。
